episode_profile.title: Dawn Song on Data Privacy and Blockchain Solutions
episode_profile.topic_summary: Dawn Song discusses her vision for a new paradigm in data ownership and privacy, emphasizing the importance of decentralized systems and blockchain technology. She introduces her work with Oasis Labs, which aims to empower individuals to control their data and benefit from its use.

key_arguments.claim: Data ownership can enable new business models and economic growth.
key_arguments.speaker: Dawn Song
key_arguments.context: Dawn argues that recognizing data as property can lead to better economic outcomes, similar to the institutionalization of property rights in the past.

key_arguments.claim: Current machine learning systems are still vulnerable to adversarial attacks.
key_arguments.speaker: Dawn Song
key_arguments.context: Dawn highlights the ongoing challenges in developing robust learning systems that can withstand sophisticated attacks.

key_arguments.claim: The Oasis platform allows for decentralized training of machine learning models without a central server.
key_arguments.speaker: Dawn Song
key_arguments.context: Dawn explains how Oasis enables decentralized machine learning, enhancing privacy and security.

key_arguments.claim: Users can potentially earn revenue from their data in the future.
key_arguments.speaker: Dawn Song
key_arguments.context: Dawn envisions a future where individuals can control their data and receive compensation for its use.

key_arguments.claim: Secure enclaves can protect sensitive data during computation.
key_arguments.speaker: Dawn Song
key_arguments.context: Dawn discusses the role of secure enclaves in ensuring that sensitive data remains confidential during processing.

key_arguments.claim: Differential privacy can enhance the protection of sensitive information in machine learning models.
key_arguments.speaker: Dawn Song
key_arguments.context: Dawn describes how differential privacy techniques can prevent sensitive data from being leaked during model training.
